text:
alex: Heads-up — I'm seeing ~150/s of EU prod traffic routed to us-west variants over the last 5m. Latency spikes and a few fallback loops. console shows a sudden bump in 'route_override' events.

maya: Any recent policy changes? I only saw a tiny tweak to tier thresholds yesterday.

javier: I rolled out a small change to tier->region precedence at 12:22 but it was gated. Did it make it to prod?

sam: @javier I reverted that change in the staging branch but deploy-bot shows a post-deploy hook ran at 12:27 from ci/routing-service

deploy-bot: deploy completed: routing-service v2026.4 (shasum: abc123) — rollout 20% -> 100% in 5m

nina: Console: customer-tier=gold traffic from EU1 got assigned 'variant=v3-quant' which we don't have in eu-region. That triggers model compatibility fallback to us-west v3-quant, then a variant-incompatibility retry back to eu-primary -> loop.

alex: Exact symptom: prefix cache miss + async cross-region fetch -> failing fast -> fallback to alternative region -> request re-queues -> counts as a new request under quota leading to throttle and another fallback. It's amplifying.

sam: Posting current routing policy snippet I pulled from the admin API:

```
route_precedence:
  - match: customer_tier == 'enterprise'
    action: prefer_region
  - match: region == request.region
    action: prefer_variant
  - match: model_variant.compatible == true
    action: allow_fallback
```

maya: That snippet looks wrong — prefer_region is above prefer_variant so non-compatible variant preference can win if tier matches. We intended region affinity to be weaker than variant compatibility.

javier: I accidentally promoted the tier rule during a refactor (my PR 782). Looks like it made it through canary.

ops-bot: Alert created: RTE-4726 routing-loop-detected — linked to policy-change PR: 782

alex: Immediate mitigation: 1) rollback PR 782 2) enable circuit-breaker on cross-region fallbacks (threshold 5/min) 3) add telemetry -> metric 'cross_region_fallback_rate' + per-tenant tag

nina: I'll patch the console dashboard to show cross_region_fallback_rate and set an alert at 1/min for gold/enterprise tiers.

sam: I'll push a hotfix that moves 'model_variant.compatible' above tier precedence and ship a canary at 10% now.

maya: Also suggest a cooldown for requeued requests to avoid double counting in quota bins.

alex: Meeting in 15 to triage root cause and rollout the fix. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

javier: sorry, my bad. will join and stay on the fix.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: routing-policy-hotfix v2026.4.1 -> 10% on eu1
